intent: A recommended insight or opportunity as a compact card, with tone and optional actions.
useWhen: surface a recommendation, warning, or finding on a dashboard
next to Scorecards when the metric needs a suggested action

tone.note: Colors the tone icon. success (CircleCheck, icon-success) for good news that is done, e.g. a payment received.

primaryAction.note: kit Button primary (one primary per view), or a text link when it has href or actionStyle is link.

href.note: Navigates: renders a real <a> text link with a trailing arrow, never a Button.

secondaryAction.note: kit Button secondary, or a text link when it has href or actionStyle is link.

href.note: Navigates: renders a real <a> text link with a trailing arrow, never a Button.

actionStyle.note: link: actions render as text links ("View invoice →"): <a> with href, otherwise a button styled as a link. For alert tiles, and when the view's one primary Button is used elsewhere.

onDismiss.note: text Dismiss control, not a Button cousin

requirements: An action with href is a real link (<a>); link-style onClick actions are buttons; the trailing arrow is aria-hidden

doNot: Do not invent local InsightCard, Insight, or RecommendationCard
Do not put a metric as the title (that is Scorecard)
Actions are kit Buttons or the kit text link (href / actionStyle link); do not pass your own links or buttons
Do not make a navigating action a Button — give it href
One primary per view (the primaryAction is the one)
snippet: <InsightCard title="Rebook no-shows automatically" description="Fill empty slots from the waitlist when clients cancel." tone="opportunity" primaryAction={{ label: "Review" }} />
